title: Circumference
text: The circumference of a unit circle is $$2\pi$$.

title: Fraction of the circumference
text: If $$\theta=7\pi/4$$ then the total circumference of the circle travelled is $$\frac{\frac{7\pi}{4}}{2\pi}$$

title: Identify the point
text: The angle $$\theta$$ is $$\frac{7}{8} th$$ of the circumference of the circle, moving in the counterclockwise direction. That corresponds to point D.

title: Identify the point
text: Note that $$\frac{7}{8} th$$ of the way around the circle in the counterclockwise direction is the same as $$\frac{1}{8} th$$ of the way around the circle in the clockwise direction.
